result.instruction: In `skid_buffer_core`, replace the binary `occupancy` counter and separate `out_valid_reg` with two state registers: `nonempty` drives `out_valid`, and `full` directly represents two queued entries for the `in_ready` rule. Update those flags for push-only and pop-only transfers, holding them on simultaneous push/pop and idle; preserve the existing data movement, synchronous reset, handshake behavior, and minimum one-cycle transfer age. Keep the top interface and `// @latency 1` annotation, and judge the candidate against the incumbent using routed reports and all existing verification gates.
